plus_ps_combo.name: PlusShadowDistance
plus_ps_combo.tool_tip: How far the sun's shadows reach, and how sharp they stay there. Far and Very far use finer shadow maps (more video memory).

plus_ps_combo.name: PlusShadowPrecision
plus_ps_combo.tool_tip: How thin a shadow (legs, railings, hair) stays at a distance. Fine and Very fine use finer shadow maps (more video memory).

plus_ps_combo.name: PlusShadowFocus
plus_ps_combo.tool_tip: Where the finest shadows go. The subject: your avatar (or what the camera is pointed at) and its shadow get the finest shadow map the screen allows, wherever it stands; things much nearer or farther get coarser ones. Snapshots always use the subject.

plus_ps_combo.name: PlusShadowSoftness
plus_ps_combo.tool_tip: How sharp or soft the edges of the sun's shadows are. Kept in snapshots; does not change the preset in use.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: PlusShadowWorldLock
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Steady light through thin gaps
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Keeps the light through thin gaps (a fence's slits) from coming and going as the camera moves, by not turning the shadows' grid with the camera. The shadows get a little coarser. Not available at some graphics levels.

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: IndirectMaxComplexity
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: Maximum complexity:
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: Controls at what point a visually complex avatar is drawn as a JellyDoll

plus_ps_check_compat.name: texture compression
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Enable Texture Compression (requires restart)
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Compresses textures in video memory, allowing for higher resolution textures to be loaded at the cost of some color quality.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: taa
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Temporal AA (TAA: smooths thin lines)
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Temporal anti-aliasing: mixes the last few frames into this one, so thin lines and edges that stay jagged or flicker smooth out where the view is still. It comes after the anti-aliasing above, which stays as it is set (FXAA or SMAA and TAA are both used). Moving things may leave a faint trail. Saved snapshots are taken without it. Light; takes effect at once, no restart.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: use HiDPI
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Enable support for HiDPI displays (requires restart)

plus_ps_spinner.name: fpslimit
plus_ps_spinner.label: Frame rate limit (0 = none):
plus_ps_spinner.tool_tip: The most frames per second the viewer makes. 0 = no limit. Lowers the load and heat of the graphics card when VSync is off. With VSync on, a value above the monitor's refresh rate does nothing.

plus_ps_button_compat.name: fpslimit_match
plus_ps_button_compat.label: Match
plus_ps_button_compat.tool_tip: Match the monitor's refresh rate: sets the limit to the refresh rate of the monitor this window is on. With VSync on, a 59.94 Hz style rate (59, 119, 143, 239 as Windows reports it) is set one higher (60, 120, 144, 240), so that VSync sets the pace without a hitch.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: vsync
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Enable VSync
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Synchronizes the frame rate to the refresh rate of the monitor, which results in smooth performance.

plus_ps_combo.name: MaxTextureResolution
plus_ps_combo.tool_tip: Maximum resolution for 'level of detail' textures

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: TonemapMix
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: Tone Mapping Mix:
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: Mix between linear and tone mapped colors

plus_ps_check_compat.name: UseDoF
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Enable depth of field (the view is blurred except where the camera is focused)

plus_ps_check_compat.name: RenderDepthOfFieldInEditMode
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Also while editing
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Keeps depth of field on while you build or edit objects.

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: CameraFNum
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: Camera f-number:
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: The f-number of the camera for depth of field: lower blurs more of what is out of focus.

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: CameraFocal
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: Focal length (mm):
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: The focal length of the camera for depth of field, in millimetres.

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: Camera FOV
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: Field of view (degrees):
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: The vertical field of view of the camera for depth of field, in degrees.

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: CameraFocusTrans
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: Focus transition time:
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: How long the focus takes to move from one place to the next, in seconds.

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: CameraDoFResScale
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: Depth of field quality:
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: The quality of the blur: higher looks better, lower is faster.

plus_ps_combo.name: PlusUpscale
plus_ps_combo.tool_tip: Draws the world smaller than the window and brings it up to the window's size, for more frames per second where the graphics card sets the pace. The HUD, name tags and the UI stay sharp; snapshots are taken at the full size, and while the photo screen or the photo tools (not minimized) are open the world is drawn at the full size too, so the frame rate drops there.

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: PlusUpscaleScale
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: Render scale:
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: The share of the window's width and height the world is drawn at: 0.77 quality, 0.67 balanced, 0.59 faster, 0.5 fastest.

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: PlusUpscaleSharpness
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: Sharpening:
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: How much the upscaled picture is sharpened (0: not at all, 1: the most). A matter of taste.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: PlusGtao
plus_ps_check_compat.label: GTAO (finer shade in corners)
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Ground-truth ambient occlusion in place of the standard one: the shade in corners, under furniture and where surfaces meet. Needs Screen Space Ambient Occlusion (General tab), which it replaces. Costs graphics card time (see the quality).

plus_ps_combo.name: PlusGtaoQuality
plus_ps_combo.tool_tip: Low and Medium work on a quarter of the pixels (8 and 24 samples); High on every pixel. Higher is finer and slower.

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: PlusGtaoStrength
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: GTAO strength:
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: How dark occluded places get: 1 as measured, 2 darker, 0 none.

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: PlusGtaoRadius
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: GTAO reach (m):
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: How far away a surface still shades another, in metres. Larger: broader, softer shade.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: PlusSsgi
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Indirect light (SSGI)
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: The colour of nearby lit surfaces (sunny ground, a red wall) comes back into the shade beside them. Needs GTAO, Screen Space Ambient Occlusion, HDR and the reflection probes.

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: PlusSsgiStrength
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: Indirect light strength:
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: How much of the light nearby surfaces send back is added (1: all that is gathered).

plus_ps_check_compat.name: PlusSSR
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Reflections: New Method
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Screen-space reflections, new method: reflections reach farther, and slightly rough floors get blurred ones too. Needs Screen Space Reflections (General tab) on. A little slower. Glass, alpha and water keep the standard reflections.

plus_ps_combo.name: OITMode
plus_ps_combo.tool_tip: Draws overlapping transparent surfaces (hair, eyelashes, glass, smoke) in their true order, so hair edges no longer cut holes in what is behind them. Grayed out on graphics cards that lack the features OIT needs.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: OITSnapshotFull
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Take snapshots with full OIT
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Snapshots are rendered with OIT on everything, whatever the setting above is. Slower to take.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: PlusMaterialize
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Materialize objects as their textures arrive
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: While its textures load, an object is drawn as glowing lines; when they arrive, a band of light sweeps up it and leaves the real surfaces behind. Objects whose textures are already at hand (the cache) show at once, without it. Needs the wireframe while textures load (the debug setting RenderGrayTextureWireframe, on by default).

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: PlusMaterializeSeconds
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: Materialize time (s):
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: How long the band of light takes to sweep from the bottom of an object to its top, in seconds.

plus_ps_combo.name: PlusMaterializePalette
plus_ps_combo.tool_tip: The colour of the lines and of the band of light. Custom: the colour of the swatch on the right.

color_swatch.name: PlusMaterializeColor
color_swatch.tool_tip: A colour of your own for the lines and the band of light. Picking one sets the glow colour to Custom. Its brightness is used as it is; a colour close to black gives cyan.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: PlusMaterializeAvatar
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Materialize avatars too
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: An avatar drawn as glowing lines while it loads (yours after login, others whose clothes are not loaded yet) is swept once by the band of light from its feet to its head when it has everything, and the real body, clothes and attachments appear. Up to 8 avatars at once; avatars already at hand show at once.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: PlusDerez
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Crumble objects as they vanish
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: When an object near you is deleted or returned (yours or someone else's), it breaks into small glowing cubes that drift up and fade, instead of vanishing at once. Not for attachments, avatars, physical objects or teleports.

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: PlusDerezSeconds
plus_ps_slider_compat.label: Crumble time (s):
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: How long a vanishing object takes to crumble away, in seconds.

plus_ps_combo.name: PlusDerezPalette
plus_ps_combo.tool_tip: The colour of the glowing edge where the object breaks apart. Custom: the colour of the swatch on the right.

color_swatch.name: PlusDerezColor
color_swatch.tool_tip: A glow colour of your own for objects that crumble away. Picking one sets the glow colour to Custom.
